items.title: Does the review board's backlog grow or shrink over time?
items.description: L3's numbers: new ADRs arrive at about 8/month, and the board reviews about 5/month — a net gap of 3 unreviewed decisions every month, compounding. Drag how many new decisions arrive each month and how many the board can actually review, then watch the backlog's trend over time. The lesson: it isn't the raw numbers that matter, it's whether throughput exceeds arrivals — cross that line and an existing backlog starts shrinking instead of growing without bound.

params.name: reviewCapacityPerMonth
params.label: ADRs the board can review per month

items.compute: const netPerMonth = params.arrivalsPerMonth - params.reviewCapacityPerMonth; const backlogSize = Math.max(0, netPerMonth * params.monthsElapsed); return { backlogSize };
